meta.description: Schema for the Adventures blog. Deliberately holds no content: a seed is applied on the first request of an empty database, so fixtures here would reach production.

x-bylineFields.description: Custom fields of an EmDash byline. NOT part of EmDash's seed format (a seed has no way to define byline fields, and its `bylines[]` carry no custom values), so EmDash ignores this key; scripts/emdash-byline-migrate.mjs reads it and applies the fields through the admin API, on a fresh database and on an existing one alike. The byline's fixed columns are not listed because they exist already: display_name (name), bio, avatar_media_id (photo), website_url (profile URL, Person.url and article:author), user_id (the admin user it is keyed to), locale.
